text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today! The 
days of focused training at the lodge 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...The hospital again? Man, you sure don't 
give up, do you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just hurry up and go to the training camp 
lodge. You don't need to keep me company, 
you know.

And so, after visiting the clinic to get 
Tosen Jordan's hooves examined and 
treated, we rejoined the summer training 
camp.
